related.title: 區域能源熱電聯供系統
related.titleEn: District Energy Combined Heat and Power Systems
related.transfer: 可遷移「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」與「蓄熱槽可支撐的時數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；區域能源熱電聯供系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling" and "Hours the heat stores can carry" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of District Energy Combined Heat and Power Systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦由燃煤轉為生質能的熱電廠：超超臨界參數、木質顆粒與麥稈的用量、蓄熱槽與供應鏈排放；區域能源熱電聯供系統則以同時賣電又賣熱的城市能源系統：抽汽的代價、一次能源節省、蓄熱、回水溫度、管網熱損、熱泵與煙氣冷凝為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A heat and power plant converted from coal to biomass: ultra-supercritical steam, pellet and straw consumption, heat storage and supply-chain emissions; District Energy Combined Heat and Power Systems centres on A city energy system selling power and heat together: cost of extraction, primary energy saving, heat storage, return temperature, network loss, heat pumps and flue-gas condensation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「汽電共生的總效率」與「汽電共生的總效率」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「潛變壽命與 Larson–Miller 參數」的模型移到區域能源熱電聯供系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「回水溫度與輸送能力」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Total efficiency of cogeneration" and "Total efficiency of cogeneration".
Move the model of "Creep life and the Larson–Miller parameter" to District Energy Combined Heat and Power Systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Return temperature and carrying capacity", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」與「蓄熱槽可支撐的時數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；區域能源熱電聯供系統的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling" and "Hours the heat stores can carry" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of District Energy Combined Heat and Power Systems must be respecified.

related.title: 燃氣複循環熱回收鍋爐
related.titleEn: Combined Cycle Heat Recovery Steam Generators
related.transfer: 可遷移「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」與「蓄熱槽可支撐的時數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；燃氣複循環熱回收鍋爐的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling" and "Hours the heat stores can carry" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Combined Cycle Heat Recovery Steam Generators must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦由燃煤轉為生質能的熱電廠：超超臨界參數、木質顆粒與麥稈的用量、蓄熱槽與供應鏈排放；燃氣複循環熱回收鍋爐則以把燃氣渦輪機的廢熱變成蒸汽：可回收的熱、蒸汽產量與夾點、鍋爐效率與汽包的升溫限制為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A heat and power plant converted from coal to biomass: ultra-supercritical steam, pellet and straw consumption, heat storage and supply-chain emissions; Combined Cycle Heat Recovery Steam Generators centres on turning gas turbine exhaust into steam: recoverable heat, steam output and the pinch, boiler efficiency and drum heating limits, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「汽電共生的總效率」與「壓力比與布雷頓循環」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「潛變壽命與 Larson–Miller 參數」的模型移到燃氣複循環熱回收鍋爐，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「汽包的升溫限制與啟動時間」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Total efficiency of cogeneration" and "Pressure ratio and the Brayton cycle".
Move the model of "Creep life and the Larson–Miller parameter" to Combined Cycle Heat Recovery Steam Generators, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Drum heating limit and start-up time", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「熱源溫度與卡諾上限」與「蓄熱槽可支撐的時數」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；燃氣複循環熱回收鍋爐的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Source temperature and the Carnot ceiling" and "Hours the heat stores can carry" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Combined Cycle Heat Recovery Steam Generators must be respecified.

history.title: 阿維多爾多燃料熱電聯產電廠
history.titleEn: Avedøre Multi-Fuel Combined Heat and Power Plant
history.text: 1990 年一號機開始商轉；2001 年二號機開始商轉；2016 年一號機完成生質燃料改造。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1990: Unit 1 entered service. 2001: Unit 2 entered service. 2016: Unit 1 completed conversion to biomass. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
